variants.v0: ReLU baseline: Linear(2048,256)->ReLU->Linear(256,K), forward only on the 18 Hub checkpoints (R2-identical pipeline; scope-guarded to match R2)
variants.v1: softmax-top-k gating: Linear(2048,256)->Linear(256,K)->softmax, top-k k=min(K,4) soft (renormalized) assignment; trained from scratch (weights not reused, structure only) with VQ reconstruction: codebook (K,2048) reconstructs the preprocessed input embedding; loss = MSE
variants.v2: v1 + 1 resident shared code (always active, fixed assignment weight 1/(k+1), extra codebook row) + Switch-style aux loss L_aux = 0.01*K*sum_i f_i*P_i (f_i = batch top-k selection frequency, detached load; P_i = mean gate probability)

training.seed_rule: crc32('exp07|{config}|{seed_idx}') mod 1e6 + 20261022 (identical across v1/v2 -> paired comparison; distinct across configs -> independent replicates)
training.init: hidden layer default PyTorch init; final gate layer ZERO-init (avoids softmax saturation at step 0 under raw-scale inputs, norm~165 - verified in development benchmark); codebook DATA-init (batch rows + N(0, 0.01*std) noise, standard VQ practice)

method.grid: 18 configs = K{8,16,64} x method{differentiable_pr,reinforce_ema} x preproc{raw,zscore,none}; method label NOMINAL for from-scratch VQ training (disclosed); preproc=none fed raw (same as R2)
method.metrics: PRIMARY = per-sample exp(H) of the K-dim gate softmax (effective_codes_expH, R2-identical definition); SECONDARY = pooled exp(H) (entropy of mean gate distribution), usage stats (codes used, max share, Gini), top-k assignment entropy
method.determinism: OMP/MKL=1; V0 phase 1 thread (R2 parity); training 8 threads; within-process repeat check below; cross-process float32 bit-reproducibility NOT assumed (R2-ERRATUM finding), noise-aware tolerance 1e-5 for cross-round comparisons

routers.note: V0 only; V1/V2 reuse structure only

determinism_check.description: same (variant,config,seed) trained twice in one process
determinism_check.finding: If 1-thread repeats are bit-identical while 8-thread repeats are not, the per-run non-determinism is threaded float reduction order, amplified over 300 chaotic training steps (rich-get-richer gate dynamics). Individual run outcomes are then NOT bit-reproducible; all statistics rest on seed-level aggregation (3 seeds x 18 configs), and the float-noise-induced run-to-run spread (see max_abs_diff) is disclosed as part of the replicate variance. Cross-process float32 bit-reproducibility is not assumed in this sandbox (R2-ERRATUM finding).

v0_reference.note: V0 deterministic (no seeds); R2 measured exp(H)=1.0000-1.0098 (thorough collapse).

v1.note: Not confirmed: pre-registered per-sample criterion exp(H)|K=64 >= 2x exp(H)|K=8 is met in 2/4 cells (raw|differentiable_pr: 1.58 FAIL; zscore|differentiable_pr: 1.82 FAIL; raw|reinforce_ema: 2.21 PASS; zscore|reinforce_ema: 2.88 PASS); pooled mean ratio 2.12 CI95 [1.7, 2.62]. NOT refuted: exp(H) at K=64 = 5.74-8.61 vs V0 collapse ~1.010 (5.7-8.5x relief); per-sample exp(H) K8->K64: raw 3.07->5.74, zscore 3.66->8.61. Two metric families disagree: pooled exp(H) ratio mean 3.80 (cells 4/4) meets >=2 while the per-sample criterion does not -> contradictory per instruction §4(e) and D1 (测不出!=已证伪); n=60 + 3 seeds = mechanism observation only.

v2.note: Not confirmed: pre-registered per-sample criterion exp(H)|K=64 >= 2x exp(H)|K=8 is met in 0/4 cells (raw|differentiable_pr: 1.56 FAIL; zscore|differentiable_pr: 1.14 FAIL; raw|reinforce_ema: 1.39 FAIL; zscore|reinforce_ema: 1.09 FAIL); pooled mean ratio 1.30 CI95 [1.12, 1.47]. NOT refuted: exp(H) at K=64 = 3.63-4.02 vs V0 collapse ~1.010 (3.6-4.0x relief); per-sample exp(H) K8->K64: raw 2.76->4.02, zscore 3.24->3.63. Two metric families disagree: pooled exp(H) ratio mean 6.96 (cells 4/4) meets >=2 while the per-sample criterion does not -> contradictory per instruction §4(e) and D1 (测不出!=已证伪); n=60 + 3 seeds = mechanism observation only.

verdict.boundary: n=60 + 3 seeds/config = mechanism observation only; 不得称'已根治' (instruction §4). Per-sample exp(H) is the pre-registered criterion metric (R2-identical); pooled/usage metrics are secondary and their disagreement with the primary is disclosed, not silently resolved (D1/D2).
verdict.ia_support: V2 (resident + load balancing) vs V1, paired by (config, seed): per-sample exp(H) delta at K=64 = -2.75 (CI95 [-3.93, -1.66]), pooled exp(H) delta = +23.84 (CI95 [20.89, 26.88]), codes-used delta = +20.50 (CI95 [19.0, 22.06]). Usage-level relief is clearly stronger for V2 (pooled exp(H) up to 53/64 codes and up to 42/64 codes used) -> directionally consistent with I-A (resident expert + load balancing relieves dead experts) as a mechanism observation; NOT a confirmed upgrade of I-A (per-sample proportionality criterion not met by either variant).
